import sys
sys.path.insert\(0, ''.''\)
import librosa
import numpy as np

# tax.mp3を読み込み
y, sr = librosa.load\(''../tax.mp3'', sr=22050, mono=True, duration=60.0\)
print\(f''Audio loaded: {len\(y\)} samples, sr={sr}, duration={len\(y\)/sr:.1f}s''\)

# オンセット検出
onset_env = librosa.onset.onset_strength\(y=y, sr=sr\)
onset_frames_detected = librosa.onset.onset_detect\(onset_envelope=onset_env, sr=sr, units=''frames''\)
onset_set = set\(onset_frames_detected.tolist\(\)\)
total_frames = len\(onset_env\)
num_onsets = len\(onset_frames_detected\)
print\(f''Detected {num_onsets} onsets in {total_frames} frames''\)

# Stage 1: F1 coarse scan
best_bpm = 120.0
best_score = -1.0
tolerance = 3
top_candidates = []

for c in range\(60, 241\):
    beat_period = 60.0 * sr / \(c * 512\)
    grid = np.arange\(0, total_frames, beat_period\)
    if len\(grid\) == 0:
        continue
    hits = 0
    for g in grid:
        g_int = int\(round\(g\)\)
        for t in range\(-tolerance, tolerance + 1\):
            if \(g_int + t\) in onset_set:
                hits += 1
                break
    precision = hits / len\(grid\)
    grid_set = set\(\)
    for g in grid:
        g_int = int\(round\(g\)\)
        for t in range\(-tolerance, tolerance + 1\):
            grid_set.add\(g_int + t\)
    onset_hits = sum\(1 for o in onset_frames_detected if int\(o\) in grid_set\)
    recall = onset_hits / max\(1, num_onsets\)
    if precision + recall > 0:
        score = 2 * precision * recall / \(precision + recall\)
    else:
        score = 0.0
    top_candidates.append\(\(c, score, precision, recall\)\)
    if score > best_score:
        best_score = score
        best_bpm = float\(c\)

top_candidates.sort\(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True\)
print\(f''\\n=== Stage 1 Results \(F1 coarse scan\) ===''\)
print\(f''Best: {best_bpm:.0f} BPM \(F1={best_score:.4f}\)''\)
for c, s, p, r in top_candidates[:10]:
    print\(f''  BPM {c}: P={p:.4f} R={r:.4f} F1={s:.4f}''\)

# Stage 2: Autocorrelation refinement
coarse_bpm = best_bpm
ac = librosa.autocorrelate\(onset_env\)
if ac[0] > 0:
    ac = ac / ac[0]

hop_onset = 512
expected_lag = 60.0 * sr / \(coarse_bpm * hop_onset\)
expected_lag_int = int\(round\(expected_lag\)\)

search_radius = 5
search_lo = max\(1, expected_lag_int - search_radius\)
search_hi = min\(len\(ac\) - 2, expected_lag_int + search_radius\)

print\(f''\\n=== Stage 2: Autocorrelation ===''\)
print\(f''Coarse BPM: {coarse_bpm:.0f}, expected lag: {expected_lag:.2f} frames''\)
print\(f''Search window: [{search_lo}, {search_hi}]''\)

# AC values in search window
for lag in range\(search_lo, search_hi + 1\):
    bpm_at_lag = 60.0 * sr / \(lag * hop_onset\)
    print\(f''  lag={lag}: ac={ac[lag]:.6f}, bpm={bpm_at_lag:.1f}''\)

peak_idx = search_lo + int\(np.argmax\(ac[search_lo:search_hi + 1]\)\)

if 0 < peak_idx < len\(ac\) - 1:
    alpha = float\(ac[peak_idx - 1]\)
    beta = float\(ac[peak_idx]\)
    gamma = float\(ac[peak_idx + 1]\)
    denom = alpha - 2.0 * beta + gamma
    delta = 0.5 * \(alpha - gamma\) / denom if abs\(denom\) > 1e-10 else 0.0
    refined_lag = peak_idx + delta
else:
    refined_lag = float\(peak_idx\)

refined_bpm = 60.0 * sr / \(refined_lag * hop_onset\)
print\(f''\\nPeak at lag={peak_idx}, ac={ac[peak_idx]:.6f}''\)
print\(f''Parabolic interpolation: delta={delta:.4f}, refined_lag={refined_lag:.4f}''\)
print\(f''Refined BPM: {refined_bpm:.2f} -> rounded: {round\(refined_bpm, 1\)}''\)
print\(f''Difference from coarse: {abs\(refined_bpm - coarse_bpm\):.2f} BPM''\)
")
